# Veklom — Capability OS for Governed Machine Action
> Structured manifests, claim registries, and evidence indexes for autonomous clients.
> Maintained at: https://veklom.com

## What Veklom Is
Veklom is a Capability Operating System for governed machine action.
Machines receive capabilities (not open-ended authority), execute through a governed boundary, and produce tamper-evident evidence of what occurred.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- /api/machine/manifest.json — full service manifest with canonical SHA
- /api/machine/claims.json — structured conformance claim registry
- /api/machine/conformance.json — G0A/G0B/G1/P5 status
- /api/machine/evidence-index.json — evidence artifact index with hashes
- /api/machine/routes.json — full route manifest
- /api/machine/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 spec

## Canonical Evidence
- Canonical tag: veklom-p5-closure-v1
- Canonical SHA: b48007614bee92d1caacc628d96fe9a786e8cd47
- Adversarial tests: 75/75 passing
- TLA+ safety checked (liveness NOT claimed)
- Correspondence verified at stated boundary

## What Is NOT Claimed
- Liveness is not formally proven
- G1 (offline sovereign execution) is partially verified (1/5 sub-gates)
- NoIllegalTruthTransition proves state membership, not full edge history
